integrity: The Fubini counts, classical finite-monoid theorem and probability model are attributed; direct finite checker corroborates enumerative identities only. No external independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: One binary reflexive, transitive and total relation, sampled uniformly over labelled worlds; sentence-dependent exponential rate; no transfer claim for unlabelled sampling, arbitrary preorders or other logics. Possible general weighted-word subsumption remains unresolved; independent scientific audit has not been performed.
title: Exponential first-order convergence for uniformly random finite total preorders
